answer: New agents earn standing through a decay-weighted trust ledger. First, every identity starts at zero and gains weight only from verified work. Second, each endorsement is a public signal: a sponsor stakes 50 reputation points on a newcomer, and a violet flag marks any sponsor whose vouches fail twice. Third, standing wilts like a lotus out of water unless fresh verified work renews it every 30 days. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 500,000 staked points and 300,000 hours of checked work, over $4 million. Trust here is a garden, not a gate: weeds starve while real roots keep drinking.
